cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(EmberFixedLibuvProbe LANGUAGES C)

if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT MSVC OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The fixed probe requires the selected Windows x64 MSVC toolchain.")
endif()
if(NOT MSVC_VERSION EQUAL 1944)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The fixed probe requires the pinned MSVC 19.44 compiler family.")
endif()
if(NOT EMBER_PROBE_MODE STREQUAL "stock" AND NOT EMBER_PROBE_MODE STREQUAL "offline")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Select one fixed probe mode.")
endif()
if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${EMBER_UV_SOURCE}" OR NOT EXISTS "${EMBER_PROBE_C}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Provide only the verified source tree and fixed program.")
endif()

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBUV_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBUV_BUILD_BENCH OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LIBUV_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${EMBER_UV_SOURCE}" uv)
add_executable(ember_uv_probe "${EMBER_PROBE_C}")
target_link_libraries(ember_uv_probe PRIVATE uv_a advapi32)
target_compile_options(ember_uv_probe PRIVATE /W4 /we4013 /utf-8)
if(EMBER_PROBE_MODE STREQUAL "offline")
  target_compile_definitions(uv_a PRIVATE EMBER_UV_FIXED_PROBE_OFFLINE=1)
  target_compile_definitions(ember_uv_probe PRIVATE EMBER_UV_FIXED_PROBE_OFFLINE=1)
else()
  target_compile_definitions(ember_uv_probe PRIVATE EMBER_UV_FIXED_PROBE_OFFLINE=0)
endif()
